Here are the errors I found:

* The sentence "the density of ice is less than that of water" is incorrect. The density of ice is actually greater than that of water, as it is more dense.
* The sentence "causing the ice to experience an upward buoyant force that allows it to remain suspended in the liquid" is illogical. Buoyancy is the upward force exerted by a fluid (in this case, water) on an object partially or fully submerged in it. Since ice is not a fluid, it cannot experience an upward buoyant force.
